body.name: Classical graphic-matroid union certificate
body.construction: Apply the classical tree-packing and matroid-union results of \cite{NashWilliams1961} and \cite{Edmonds1965} to compute \(r_q(E)\), disjoint forests \((F_1,\ldots,F_q)\), and a minimizing set in the union-rank formula involving \(c(F)\).
